data.why: The app's load_gdsc_data() checks data/raw/GDSC2_response.csv and data/raw/Expression_Data.parquet first and only falls back to a Hugging Face network fetch if either is missing; the sandbox has no network once the server starts, so the real fix is to place local files that satisfy that fallback instead of relying on the fetch. Expression_Data.parquet can't be hand-written as binary, so a small seed CSV (genes as rows, 24 NSCLC/lung cell lines as columns) is placed and converted to parquet with a one-line install command using the already-installed pandas/pyarrow. Both files include realistic EGFR-driven signal (EGFR expression anti-correlates with LN_IC50 for the four EGFR inhibitors) plus one missing expression value (MET in H23) and one missing dose-response well (Gefitinib in SW900) and an osimertinib-resistant outlier pair (H820, H1650) to exercise the app's NaN-handling and FDR/volcano logic.

goals: Select an EGFR-inhibitor compound (Erlotinib, Gefitinib, Afatinib, Osimertinib) and see which genes correlate with its drug sensitivity
Read the volcano plot to pick candidate biomarker genes that pass the Benjamini-Hochberg FDR threshold
Examine the LN(IC50) dose-response distribution and identify the most sensitive cell lines for the selected compound
Evaluate the Random Forest model's cross-validated (train) and held-out (test) R² and RMSE for predicting drug sensitivity from expression
Pick an unseen test-set cell line and compare the model's predicted LN(IC50) against the actual measured value
Review the Integrity tab to confirm the train/test-split-before-statistics and FDR methodology used to avoid data leakage

review.summary: The tree states this tool's purpose correctly: FDR-controlled expression biomarkers for EGFR inhibitors, the spread of response across cell lines with the most sensitive lines, and a leakage-aware Random Forest checked on held-out lines. Its phases follow the app, and 8 of the 10 screens checked match exactly. Before filing, fix the 'identity line' that is really an OLS trendline, add a feature for the Integrity tab, rename the 'analyte' selector, fold the two click-level tasks into t2, and reconcile the Cell Line ID / value mismatch on screen 033.
